channel.title: Fortune Owivri — Agentic AI Blueprints
channel.description: How I design, govern and test agentic AI systems.

item.title: Blueprint #1: Autonomous Ops Agent
item.description: Incident triage with explicit guardrails, approved playbooks, and escalation for anything that can't be undone — plus a sandbox you can run.

item.title: Blueprint #2: Research & Reporting Agent
item.description: Source discovery, credibility filtering and verification, with a human approving the report before it ships.

item.title: Blueprint #3: Personal Productivity Agent
item.description: An agent that plans and assists without ever committing on a person's behalf.

item.title: Ops Agent Sandbox — a testable demo
item.description: The decision layer behind Blueprint #1, running in the browser with a repeatable 14-scenario test suite and an answer key.
